# Güncel Proje Bilgileri

> > A comprehensive Turkish residential property database providing current project information, pricing, and details across major cities including Istanbul, Ankara, and İzmir.

Güncel Proje Bilgileri is a real estate information portal specializing in residential housing developments in Turkey's major metropolitan areas. The site aggregates current project listings with detailed pricing, location information, and project-specific details to help buyers and investors evaluate housing opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Istanbul residential projects
- Ankara housing developments
- İzmir property listings
- Levent district projects
- Sarıyer residential properties
- Üsküdar housing market
- Mamak district projects
- Project pricing and details
- Residential property comparison
- Real estate listings
- Housing developments
- Istanbul neighborhoods
- Apartment projects
- Property investment
- Current market listings

## Istanbul Residential Projects

- [Istanbul Konut Projeleri](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/istanbul-konut-projeleri): Istanbul residential projects directory with pricing and details
- [Istanbul Avrupa Konut Projeleri](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/istanbul-avrupa-konut-projeleri): Istanbul European side residential projects listing
- [Istanbul Anadolu Konut Projeleri](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/istanbul-anadolu-konut-projeleri): Istanbul Anatolian side residential projects directory
- [Levent Konut Projeleri](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/levent-konut-projeleri): Levent district residential projects directory
- [Beşiktaş Konut Projeleri](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/besiktas-konut-projeleri): Beşiktaş district residential projects directory
- [Sarıyer Konut Projeleri](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/sariyer-konut-projeleri): Sarıyer district residential projects with pricing
- [Arnavutköy Konut Projeleri](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/arnavutkoy-konut-projeleri): Arnavutköy district residential projects listing
- [Üsküdar Konut Projeleri](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/uskudar-konut-projeleri): Üsküdar district residential projects with pricing

## Featured Istanbul Projects

- [Rams Park House Maslak](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/istanbul-avrupa-konut-projeleri/rams-park-house-maslak): Rams Park House Maslak residential project by RAMS Türkiye
- [Polat Levent Exclusive](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/istanbul-avrupa-konut-projeleri/polat-levent-exclusive): Polat Levent Exclusive luxury project by Polat Gayrimenkul
- [Polat Akatlar](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/istanbul-avrupa-konut-projeleri/polat-akatlar): Polat Akatlar luxury project in Beşiktaş Levent-Etiler
- [Kısıklı Park](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/istanbul-anadolu-konut-projeleri/kisikli-park): Kısıklı Park residential project in Üsküdar by Summa
- [Emlak Konut Yenişehir Evleri](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/istanbul-avrupa-konut-projeleri/emlak-konut-yenisehir-evleri): Emlak Konut Yenişehir Evleri social housing in Arnavutköy
- [Martim E5](https://www.guncelprojebilgileri.com/istanbul-avrupa-konut-projeleri/martim-e5): Martim E5 commercial project in Avcılar with pricing details
